items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Billy Butterfield came today, and I haven't seen him

ctx.x: Well, do you want to know an interesting thing, Helen. I see American jazz musician friends more in Europe than ever I saw them in the States because many of them were living in Florida, many in California, you know, spread all over the country, but I see them all, men I haven't seen

in 20 years, maybe in some cases 25 years and they all come over here and we have a marvelous time. Billy Butterfield came today, and I haven't seen him, but he's staying at a hotel I used to stay, at the Century, and he's starting a tour for my agent, Robert Masters.
